newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Canada to auction C$2.7 bln bonds due 2000.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Canada to auction C$2.7 bln bonds due 2000.

text.p: The Government of Canada said on Friday it planned to auction on January 8 C$2.7 billion of bonds with a coupon of 5.5 percent and maturing on February 1, 2000.
The Bank of Canada said it will buy at least C$270 million of the new bonds.
The bonds, which will be dated and delivered on January 15, pay interest on February 1 and August 1, the government said.
Proceeds of the issue will be used for the general purposes of the Government of Canada.
There are no Government of Canada marketable bonds maturing on January 15.
